business_problem: Most ISVs with a Microsoft-based solution see multiple benefits in doing business on the Microsoft commercial marketplace, which provides the unique capability to sell through more than 140 countries. ISVs may attempt listing solutions on their own, but they could miss out on benefits like transactability or enabling customers to retire existing cloud budgets via marketplace purchases. Some ISVs experience challenges with technical integration, including structuring offers to fit their business model.
solution_summary: Most ISVs with a Microsoft-based solution see multiple benefits in doing business on the Microsoft commercial marketplace, which provides the unique capability to sell through more than 140 countries. ISVs may attempt listing solutions on their own, but they could miss out on benefits like transactability or enabling customers to retire existing cloud budgets via marketplace purchases. The Microsoft commercial marketplace offers millions of customers worldwide a convenient place to find, try, and buy software and services. But getting a solution listed and transacting can be time-consuming and complicated. Seeing the opportunity to help ISVs publish SaaS solutions to millions of potential customers on Microsoft AppSource and Azure Marketplace, WeTransact chose Microsoft Azure and Azure OpenAI Service to power its solution.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Provides large language model inference for natural language search, drafting, summarization, and recommendations.

data_flow: Content from Microsoft commercial marketplace is ingested into Azure OpenAI Service, where it is indexed, enriched, or reasoned over before grounded answers are returned to employees through business applications.
business_outcome: The results extend beyond faster marketplace publishing and initial sales. Through its tools, WeTransact helps users strengthen co-selling relationships with Microsoft, which can provide long-term customer pipelines.
